issues.description: The problem statement and template expect an interface named 'Rideable' with the method messageOnRide(), but the solution repository introduces a different interface named 'Mountable' (with messageOnRide()) and leaves Rideable.java empty. As a result, classes in the solution implement Mountable instead of Rideable, and the template/Main code that references Rideable[] will not match the solution types. This name/type mismatch between Rideable and Mountable is a structural inconsistency that will confuse students and prevent straightforward compilation/integration between the template and the provided solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the interface name and usage across all artifacts. Either (A) Rename Mountable.java to Rideable.java and ensure it declares String messageOnRide(); then have Seal and Pig implement Rideable; and remove the empty Rideable.java, or (B) Update the problem statement and template to reference 'Mountable' instead of 'Rideable'. Prefer option A to match the original specification: provide a Rideable interface with messageOnRide(), implement it in Seal and Pig, and remove the extra Mountable file.
